name: Usercentrics Consent Management Platform (CMP)
description: Integrates the Usercentrics CMP loader script and defers/blocks tracking scripts, page attachments and asset libraries until the matching Data Processing Service consent is given.

suggests.drupal/media_oembed_provider_markup: Replaces internal Drupal media oEmbed iframe URLs with the provider's HTML markup so the CMP / Smart Data Protection can recognise and block external embeds.

project_description:
This module implements the Usercentrics Consent Management Platform (CMP) from usercentrics.com .

 Users of the website must select which data processing services are to be used before loading from external sources.

 With Smart Data Protection , Usercentrics also offers a solution for obtaining consent for the integration of external content such as iframes or videos. (For this feature you may need the module Media oEmbed Provider Markup .

 Data Processing Services (DPS) are created as config entities for the necessary customization of the javascript integrations. The module provides apps for Matomo, Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager. You can enable them on /admin/config/user-interface/usercentrics/apps. See README for further information.

 Features: 
 
 Supporting Smart Data Protection (SDP) 
 Supporting Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF) 
 Supporting preview mode and disable tracking 
 Button / icon for users to change own consent presets 
 Exclude admin paths (default) 
 Exclude admin role 
 Debugging mode for creating own DPSs 
 Create and edit own Data Processing Services (DPS) as config entities. 
 
 If you are looking for an Open Source Consent Manager, take a look at klaro .
